title: H4octapa: synthesis, solution equilibria and complexes with useful radiopharmaceutical metal ions

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: sodium lanthanum(III) octapa / mixed lanthanum–sodium salt of [La(octapa)]−

material_class.structural_family: ten-coordinate [La(octapa)(H2O)2]− octapa chelate with aqua-La and Na counterions

synthesis.procedure: Na[La(octapa)] (5): H4octapa·4HCl·3H2O (0.02 g, 0.03 mmol) was dissolved in 0.1 M HCl (1 mL). La(NO3)3·6H2O (0.03 g, 0.07 mmol) was added. The mixture was brought to pH 4 by dropwise addition of 0.1 M NaOH and stirred at room temperature. After 1 h, MS indicated formation of the anion and the solvent was removed in vacuo to give a white solid. Colourless blade crystals of the mixed lanthanum–sodium salt [La(octapa)(H2O)2]2[La(H2O)6.15]1/2Na1/2 were obtained by slow evaporation of a mixture of La(NO3)3 and H4octapa in a 1.6 : 1 metal-to-ligand molar ratio at pH ~4 in water.

reagents.name: lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 0.03 g, 0.07 mmol (bulk synthesis); 1.6 : 1 metal : ligand for crystals

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.role: base / pH adjustment and Na source

synthesis.temperature: room temperature (stirring); crystals by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed in vacuo after 1 h to give a white solid. Crystals for XRD grown by slow evaporation from water at pH ~4 (1.6 : 1 La : ligand).

synthesis.procedure: Na[Sm(octapa)] (6): H4octapa·4HCl·3H2O (4) (0.02 g, 0.03 mmol) was dissolved in 0.1 M HCl (6 mL). A 50% w/w solution of Sm(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.03 g, 0.05 mmol) was added and the solution brought to pH 3.5 by slow dropwise addition of 0.1 M NaOH. After 1 h, MS indicated formation of the anion and the solvent was removed in vacuo to give a white solid.

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.role: base / pH adjustment and Na source

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed in vacuo to give a white solid.

properties.summary: Solution formation constants for Sm(Hoctapa), [Sm(octapa)]− and [Sm(octapa)(OH)]2− were determined (log K_SmL = 20.10(2)); no magnetic or luminescence data were reported.

synthesis.procedure: Na[Dy(octapa)] (7): H4octapa·4HCl·3H2O (4) (0.02 g, 0.03 mmol) was dissolved in H2O (5 mL). DyCl3·6H2O (0.02 g, 0.05 mmol) was added. The pH was brought to 7 by slow dropwise addition of 0.5 M NaOH. After 1 h, MS indicated formation of the anion and the solvent was removed in vacuo to give a white solid.

synthesis.procedure: Na[Yb(octapa)] (8): H4octapa·4HCl·3H2O (4) (0.02 g, 0.03 mmol) was dissolved in H2O (5 mL). YbCl3·6H2O (0.02 g, 0.05 mmol) in water was added. The pH was brought to 7 by slow dropwise addition of 0.5 M NaOH. After 1 h, MS indicated formation of product and the solvent was removed in vacuo to give a white solid.
